name: Quantum Engraving #006 — Oxide Interface
description:
The delicate threshold where crystalline semiconductor silicon embraces its transparent dielectric native oxide (SiO2, 1-5 μm). A visual and physical exploration of abrupt thermal and optical impedance: as laser irradiation crosses the boundary, thin-film constructive interference manifests in prismatic rainbow fringes of electric cyan, magenta, and chromatic gold across the vitreous boundary.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes Boundary Condition 6: temperature continuity (T- = T+) and normal heat flux jump (k- ∇T- · n = k+ ∇T+ · n).

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
